description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the I18NService component within the OrangeHRM system. It contains various unit tests to verify translation retrieval, cache key generation, and other behaviors of the I18NService class, specifically testing internationalization (i18n) functionalities.

classes.name: I18NServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies various aspects of the I18NService, including translation accuracy, cache key generation, ETag handling, and multi-language support within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: testGetI18NDao
methods.description: Verifies that the getI18NDao() method returns an instance of I18NDao.

methods.name: testGetTranslator
methods.description: Tests that getTranslator() returns a Translator instance with the correct locale and translation behavior.

methods.name: testGetTranslationCollection
methods.description: Checks that the translation collection fetched for a given language contains correct key-target mappings.

methods.name: testGenerateCacheKeyPrefixForLang
methods.description: Validates the correctness of cache key prefix generation based on language code.

methods.name: testGenerateTranslationCacheKey
methods.description: Verifies the cache key generated for translation cache for a given language.

methods.name: testGenerateTranslationKeyTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Checks cache key generation for the translation key-target array for a specific language.

methods.name: testGenerateTranslationSourceTargetArrayCacheKey
methods.description: Validates cache key generation for the translation source-target array.

methods.name: testGenerateETagCacheKey
methods.description: Ensures the ETag cache key is generated correctly based on language code.

methods.name: testGetETagByLangCode
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the ETag for a language, verifying caching and consistency.

methods.name: testGetETagByLangCodeWithMultipleLanguages
methods.description: Verifies ETag retrieval behaves correctly across multiple languages and cache usage.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesAsJsonString
methods.description: Checks that translation messages are correctly serialized to JSON string for a language.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesKeyTargetArray
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of translation key-target mappings.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesKeyTargetArrayWithInCaseNotCreatedCache
methods.description: Tests cache fallback and regeneration when cache is cleared for key-target array.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesSourceTargetArray
methods.description: Checks the source-target translation mapping for a language.

methods.name: testGetTranslationMessagesSourceTargetArrayWithInCaseNotCreatedCache
methods.description: Verifies fallback to fetching and caching source-target translations after cache invalidation.

methods.name: testTrans
methods.description: Tests the trans() method for translating keys with optional parameters and language fallback.

methods.name: testTransWithMultipleLanguages
methods.description: Checks translation behavior when multiple languages are involved and cache mechanisms are exercised.

methods.name: testTransBySource
methods.description: Verifies translation lookup by source text instead of key.

methods.name: getMockI18NDao
methods.description: Creates a mocked I18NDao returning specified translation data, used for testing.
